newsitem.headline: TABLE- IBS Financial Q3 June 30 shr $0.15.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: The company reported other operating income of $206,000 compared with $247,000.
Per share amounts for prior periods have been restated to reflect the 15 percent stock dividend declared March 21 and paid May 6.
Weighted average shares and per share amouunts reflect the effects of the company's stock repurchase plans during the respective periods.

The company reported assets at June 30 of $733.3 million and $742.1 million at Sept. 30, 1996. Loans were $202.8 million compared with $185.0 million. Deposits were $565.0 million compared with $571.4 million.

The company said its decrease in net income for the quarter and nine months is principally the result of a decline in net interest income. It said these declines were partially offset by reduced income tax provisions.
The company's full name is IBS Financial Corp.
